Profhilo Treatment

Skin looking dull, crepey or a little loose, even though you take care of it? Profhilo is an ultra-pure hyaluronic acid treatment that melts under the skin to hydrate it deeply and boost collagen. Just 10 tiny injections, two sessions a month apart, and your skin looks firmer, smoother and glowing, still completely you.

15–30 minTreatment time

Treatment overview

What is Profhilo?

As we age, skin loses hyaluronic acid, collagen and elastin, the three things that keep it plump, firm and bouncy. The result is skin that looks dull, feels dry and starts to look crepey or slightly loose, especially on the cheeks, under the eyes and on the neck.

Profhilo puts back what's missing. It's one of the most concentrated hyaluronic acid treatments available, made with a special hybrid formula that lets it spread evenly under the skin from just 10 injection points. There it hydrates deeply and stimulates your own collagen and elastin. This is called bio-remodelling: improving the quality of the skin itself rather than adding volume.

Read more: why Profhilo isn't a filler

Fillers are thick gels placed in specific spots to add shape, for example to lips or cheeks. Profhilo is very fluid. It "melts" and spreads like a sheet under the skin, so it doesn't change your features or make you look puffy.

That's why Profhilo is often used alongside fillers and Botox. Profhilo improves the skin, fillers restore lost volume and Botox softens lines from movement.

1. SpreadProfhilo melts and spreads evenly under the skin from 10 points.
2. HydratePure HA draws in water for deep, lasting hydration.
3. RemodelCollagen and elastin increase, so skin becomes firmer over weeks.
One syringeProfhilo® (2 ml)
64 mgpure hyaluronic acid
32 + 32mg of high and low weight HA
0chemical cross-linkers (BDDE-free)
10injection points for the face

What's Inside a Profhilo Syringe

Profhilo combines two kinds of hyaluronic acid. Low-weight HA works fast to hydrate, while high-weight HA lasts longer and supports the skin. They're joined using heat instead of chemicals, which is why Profhilo spreads so evenly and lasts for months without making you look filled.

The technique

The 5-Point Technique, Explained

Profhilo for the face uses just 5 injection points on each side, chosen to avoid major blood vessels and nerves. Tap a number to see what each point does.

The same 5 points are used on both sides. Tap a number.

Point 1: Cheekbone

Placed just below the outer corner of the eye, on the cheekbone. Hydrates and firms the upper cheek and the skin under the eyes.

Injections1 on each side
Total per session10 points, 1 syringe

Point 2: Beside the nose

Placed near the base of the nose. Supports the mid-face and softens the start of the smile lines.

Injections1 on each side
Total per session10 points, 1 syringe

Point 3: In front of the ear

Placed just in front of the ear. Improves crepey skin on the side of the face and supports the cheek.

Injections1 on each side
Total per session10 points, 1 syringe

Point 4: Chin

Placed on either side of the chin. Hydrates the lower face and smooths lines around the mouth.

Injections1 on each side
Total per session10 points, 1 syringe

Point 5: Jaw angle

Placed at the angle of the jaw. Firms the lower face and helps the jawline look smoother.

Injections1 on each side
Total per session10 points, 1 syringe

What to expect

Benefits of Profhilo

Better skin quality from within, with a natural, fresh-faced result.

Deep Hydration

One of the most concentrated HA treatments available, hydrating skin from within.

Firmer, Tighter Skin

Stimulates collagen and elastin, so loose or crepey skin looks firmer.

Smoother Fine Lines

Softens fine lines and crepey texture across the face and neck.

Natural Glow

Brighter, bouncier, more radiant skin, without changing your features.

Not a Filler

Spreads under the skin instead of adding shape, so you look fresher, not different.

Only 10 Injections

A quick 15 to 30 minute treatment with just 5 points on each side.

Little Downtime

Face, Neck & Hands

The face is the most popular area, but Profhilo works anywhere skin is dry, thin or crepey.

The classic Profhilo treatment. 5 points on each side of the face hydrate and firm the cheeks, under-eyes, jaw and lower face in one go.

  • Smoother fine lines
  • Better skin under the eyes

Crepey neck skin and horizontal neck lines respond well to Profhilo. It's one of the most popular areas after the face.

Is it right for you?

Signs You'd Benefit from Profhilo

Your skin looks dull even after sleep and skincare
Creams work on the surface. Profhilo hydrates deep in the skin, where they can't reach.
Makeup sits in fine lines or looks cakey
A sign of dehydration. Better-hydrated skin gives makeup a smoother base.
Your skin feels thinner or looks crepey
Collagen loss makes skin look crinkly, especially under the eyes and on the neck. Profhilo helps rebuild it.
Your face looks slightly loose but you don't want fillers
Profhilo firms the skin without adding volume or changing your features.
You've lost weight or been unwell
Weight loss and illness can leave skin looking tired and lax. Profhilo helps it bounce back.

Your course

How a Profhilo Course Works

Profhilo is designed as a short course, because each session builds on the last.

  1. Session 1

    Hydration starts

    10 injections, about 15 to 30 minutes. Skin often looks more hydrated within a week.

  2. Session 2 · week 4

    Collagen boost

    The second session builds on the first and drives collagen and elastin production.

  3. Week 8

    Best results

    Skin looks firmer, smoother and glowing, with better texture.

  4. Every 6 months

    Maintain

    One session keeps your skin hydrated and firm. Mature skin may benefit from a third course session.

Your appointment

Profhilo Treatment Procedure

A proper consultation comes first.

  • Your doctor checks your skin, talks through your goals and reviews your medical history.
  • Avoid aspirin, ibuprofen, fish oil and vitamin E for a few days if your doctor agrees, to reduce bruising.
  • Skip alcohol for 24 hours before.
  • Come with clean skin and no makeup.
  • Plan around events, as small bumps can show for a day.

Treatment takes 15 to 30 minutes.

  • Your skin is cleansed and disinfected.
  • The 5 points on each side are marked.
  • A small amount of Profhilo is placed at each point with a fine needle.
  • You'll feel quick pinches and a mild sting as it goes in.
  • Small bumps form at each point. This is normal.

Most people go straight back to work. The full aftercare plan is below.

  • Bumps settle within 6 to 24 hours as the product spreads.
  • Don't massage or press the points.
  • Avoid makeup for 12 hours.
  • Skip the gym, saunas, alcohol and strong sun for 24 to 48 hours.
  • Book your second session in 4 weeks.

Results

What Results Can You Expect?

Profhilo improves skin quality gradually, so people notice you look well, not that you've had something done.

A good fit if you

  • Have dull, dry or dehydrated skin
  • See crepey skin under the eyes or on the neck
  • Have early skin laxity
  • Want natural results without fillers

Not ideal if you

  • Are pregnant or breastfeeding
  • Have an infection or cold sore in the area
  • Want to add volume to lips or cheeks (fillers suit that)
  • Have very loose skin (HIFU or surgery may help more)

Illustrative model images. Results vary from person to person.

Aftercare

Profhilo Aftercare

Simple steps that help Profhilo spread evenly and settle well.

Do

  • Leave the bumps alone. They'll settle
  • Use a cold pack if you're swollen
  • Drink plenty of water
  • Sleep on your back if you can

Avoid

  • Massaging or pressing the points
  • Makeup for 12 hours
  • Alcohol, gym, saunas and steam
  • Strong sun and heat

Do

  • Use gentle, hydrating skincare
  • Wear SPF 30 or higher every day
  • Keep drinking water
  • Book your second session

Avoid

  • Facials, peels and lasers for 2 weeks
  • Retinoids and strong acids for a few days
  • Face rollers and massage

Myths vs facts

Profhilo Myths, Busted

"Profhilo is just another filler."
Fillers add shape. Profhilo spreads under the skin to improve its quality, so it won't change your features.
"One session is enough."
Profhilo is designed as a 2-session course. The second session is what really boosts collagen.
"The bumps mean something went wrong."
Bumps are expected. They're the product before it spreads, and they settle within a day.
"It's only for older skin."
Many people start in their late 20s or 30s to keep skin hydrated and prevent early ageing.
"Results show instantly."
Hydration shows within a week, but firmness builds over about 8 weeks as collagen grows.

Safety first

Side Effects and Who Should Wait

Profhilo is made of pure hyaluronic acid and is very well tolerated. Here's what's normal and when to check with your doctor first.

Common and temporary

  • Small bumps at each injection point for 6 to 24 hours
  • Mild redness or tenderness
  • A small bruise
  • Slight swelling

Talk to your doctor first if you

  • Are pregnant or breastfeeding
  • Have an active infection, cold sore or acne flare in the area
  • Have a known allergy to hyaluronic acid
  • Take blood thinners
  • Have an autoimmune condition

Questions

Profhilo Treatment FAQs

What is Profhilo?
Profhilo is an injectable skin treatment made of one of the highest concentrations of pure hyaluronic acid available. Instead of adding volume like a filler, it spreads under the skin to hydrate it deeply and stimulate collagen and elastin, so skin looks firmer, smoother and more radiant.
Is Profhilo a filler?
No. Fillers are placed to add shape or volume. Profhilo spreads evenly under the skin to improve skin quality. It won't change your features, so you look fresher rather than different.
How many Profhilo sessions do I need?
The standard course is 2 sessions, 4 weeks apart. Mature or very loose skin may benefit from a third. After that, one session every 6 months keeps results going.
When will I see results?
Many people notice more hydrated skin within the first week. Firmer skin and better texture build after the second session, with the best results around 8 weeks after starting.
How long does Profhilo last?
About 6 months after the full course. Regular maintenance sessions help keep skin hydrated and firm.
Does Profhilo hurt?
There are only 10 small injections on the face. Most people feel quick pinches and a mild sting as the product goes in. Numbing cream can be used if you'd like.
What are the bumps after Profhilo?
Small, raised bumps at each injection point are normal. They're the product sitting under the skin before it spreads, and they usually settle within 6 to 24 hours.
Who is Profhilo suitable for?
Anyone from their late 20s onwards with dull, dry, crepey or slightly loose skin. It's suitable for all skin types and tones, including Indian skin.
Can Profhilo be combined with other treatments?
Yes. Profhilo works well with Botox, fillers, HIFU, MNRF and chemical peels. Your doctor will plan the timing between treatments.
What's the difference between Profhilo and skin boosters?
Profhilo is a type of skin booster with a very high concentration of hyaluronic acid and a special hybrid formula that spreads under the skin. It needs only 10 injection points, compared with many tiny injections for most other skin boosters.
Are there side effects?
Small bumps, mild redness, tenderness or a small bruise at the injection points are common and short-lived. Serious side effects are rare.
Who should not have Profhilo?
Profhilo isn't advised during pregnancy or breastfeeding, with an active skin infection or cold sore, or for people with a known allergy to hyaluronic acid.
Can Profhilo be used on the neck and hands?
Yes. The neck, chest and hands are popular areas. Profhilo Body treats larger areas like the arms, knees and tummy.
Where can I get Profhilo in Kerala?
Facelit offers Profhilo in Trivandrum (Kowdiar), Karunagappally (Kollam) and Guruvayur (Thrissur).
How much does Profhilo cost?
It depends on the area and number of sessions. The 2-session course gives the best results and value. Book a consultation for a personalised quote.
